'''''Axonopus compressus''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]]. It is often used as a permanent [[pasture]], groundcover, and [[Sod|turf]] in moist, low fertility soils, particularly in shaded situations.  It is generally too low-growing to be useful in cut-and-carry systems or for [[fodder]] conservation.

While not optimal, it is occasionally used for football fields especially those which are not for elite competitions or where only a low level of maintenance can be done.

==Taxonomy==
''Axonopus compressus'' is known by several common names including '''broadleaf carpetgrass''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=AXCO|taxon=Axonopus compressus|accessdate=9 January 2016}}</ref> '''carpet-grass''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> '''American carpet grass''',  '''tropical carpet grass''', '''blanket grass''', '''lawn grass''', '''Louisiana grass''', '''savanna grass''', and '''Kearsney grass'''.
